profile.summary: I do IT support at Tesla Shanghai — devices, accounts, the usual workplace stuff. On the side I write Power Automate flows and small React / Python tools so the team repeats itself less. Lately I've been poking at Dify. Outside work I take photos and turn old gadgets into smart-home experiments.

tesla.title: IT Support Technician
tesla.description:
• IT support for ~1,500 people — devices, accounts, apps, basic services; sometimes work with APAC too.
• Clean up support workflows with IT and business so the same issues don't keep coming back.
• Built 300+ Power Automate flows; saves roughly 50 hours a month.
• Write small React / Python tools for the support team and business users.
• Trying Dify and LLMs for knowledge answers and workflow hints — still early.

automation.title: IT automation & small tools
automation.description: Support work had too many repeat steps, so I killed them with Power Automate and a bit of React / Python.
automation.problem: A lot of tickets were the same steps over and over.
automation.solution: Power Automate for the flows; React / Python when a tiny tool was missing.
automation.impact: Roughly 300+ flows running, about 50 hours saved a month, covering ~1,500 people.

aiAssistant.title: AI helper for IT
aiAssistant.description: Trying Dify and LLMs so I answer fewer of the same questions.
aiAssistant.problem: Same questions, every week. Digging through docs was slow.
aiAssistant.solution: Hooked LLMs up through Dify, starting with Q&A and simple workflow tips.
aiAssistant.impact: Still building it. Once it works, I'll push it further into support.
